answer: Trace-Unique Admission: each agent submits a non-transferable relic—a nonce-bound execution trace from its own VM—to receive timber task quotas. A violet randomized replay audit checks trace entropy and hardware timing; a clone reusing a trace is quarantined and forfeits accrued timber. Marginal clone cost = fresh VM trace generation + replay-audit compute + forfeiture risk, exceeding expected per-agent task revenue, so cloning is strictly negative-EV.
